# [\#19 Issue](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/19) `open`: Create controller functions for Trip endpoints

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) opened issue at [2026-05-25 09:25](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/19):

~Create the API app routes logic for interactions with the _Trips_ collection.~

Based on recent structural changes, this issue has been updated and now entails creating the controller logic for the Trips endpoints.

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) commented at [2026-05-26 21:34](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/19#issuecomment-4549158234):

Adding the relevant endpoints from issue #11:

- [x] **POST** `/api/trips/trip-estimate` 
_Data Sent_: All the information from the trip fare estimate page. This will be used to create a fare estimate.
_Data Validated_: No because this data is not being saved to the database.
_Data Returned_: A message of success with just the total trip cost or estimated fare.

- [x] **POST** `/api/trips/book-trip`
_Data Sent_: The same information sent to the endpoint `fare-estimate`. However, the difference is this endpoint signals to save the trip in the database.
_Data Validated_: Yes to ensure the sent data fits the JSON schema for trip data. This prepares the data to be saved to the database.
_Data Returned_: A message of success or failure in the form of  JSON data. If the save operation was successful, the trip id that was saved to the database is also returned in the JSOn data.

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) commented at [2026-05-26 21:51](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/19#issuecomment-4549278094):

Updated the returned data from the endpoint `booking` to only return a message of success or failure as JSON data. There is no need for the function that handles saving the trip data to then return the full trip data again.

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) commented at [2026-05-27 05:41](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/19#issuecomment-4551689670):

Actually, perhaps both a message and, if the save is successful, the payload should be returned. While the frontend should have the data already since it was the initiator of the API call, the trip may not have an ID at that point. Just in case the frontend needs the trip ID after making the call, it would be better to return it to the frontend in the response.

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) commented at [2026-05-27 05:42](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/19#issuecomment-4551694670):

On the other hand, if only the ID needs to be sent back, then that should be added to the returned JSON data instead of the full trip data.

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) commented at [2026-05-27 05:44](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/19#issuecomment-4551707973):

Updated the _Data Returned_ section above for the `booking` endpoint.

#### <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/26848686?u=6c1f8b72ff786312cb5de7ffb1fbb1a9b8f2b464&v=4" width="50">[dEhiN](https://github.com/dEhiN) commented at [2026-05-27 06:43](https://github.com/dEhiN/CanadianBusinessCollege--FullStackWebApplicationDiploma/issues/19#issuecomment-4552079590):

Changed the API endpoint from `booking` to `book-trip`. This keeps it in a similar naming convention to the other trip POST endpoint - `fare-estimate`, which makes things less confusing.
